decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 2 - All advertisements displayed, and any land or building used for the purpose of its display, shall be maintained in a reasonably clean and tidy condition so that it does not impair the visual amenity of the site.
Condition : 3 - Any structure or hoarding erected or used principally for the purpose of displaying advertisements shall be maintained in a safe condition.

Condition : 4 - Where any advertisement is required to be removed, the removal shall leave the site in a safe condition that does not endanger the public, and in a reasonably clean and tidy condition so that it does not impair the site's visual amenity

Condition : 5 - No advertisement is to be displayed without the consent of the owner of the site (this includes land or buildings where the advertisement is displayed), nor the permission of any other person with an interest in the land entitled to give permission.
description: Retenttion of one amended internally illuminated free standing sign to the front of the property.
